notes.title: Last Content Update + Now Supporting Korean and Traditional Chinese
notes.notes:
[i]REYNATIS[/i] is a full-blown action-packed magical RPG in which two people with different perspectives fight for their ideals in a realistic recreation of modern-day Shibuya, Tokyo. The last free update is released now!

And the game now supports Korean and Traditional Chinese for the interface and subtitles.

[b]Chapter in Dream: Into the Dream[/b]
A dream once seen as "if = dream" begins to distort into a nightmare.

Only Marin holds the power to save those tormented by it—with a single word spoken in the dream. But when the dream transforms into a real battle against his greatest enemy, Marin is not alone.

Will you dare to step into the dream and rewrite destiny?

* The screenshot is from the Japanese version.

notes.title: REYNATIS - Steam Version Features & Launch Discount
notes.notes:
REYNATIS arrives on Steam, bringing exciting features that enhance your gameplay experience. Enjoy the beautiful visuals with 4K resolution and high frame rates. Whether you prefer keyboard and mouse control or gamepad, the game offers seamless compatibility. Customize your experience further with selected graphics options, ensuring the best performance on your PC. Plus, REYNATIS is playable on Steam Deck, giving you the freedom to take the action wherever you go.

Here are a few features of the PC version:

[h2]4K Resolution and High Frame Rate[/h2]
Experience REYNATIS in 4K resolution and smooth high frame rates up to 120fps. Enjoy every scene with enhanced clarity and precision.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/198a3829b00fe90151ef308fe3beb35636d1d9c9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/286c141fa0eab79be240088934fd8b3d978a6844.jpg[/img]

[h2]Keyboard and Mouse Control Support[/h2]
Customize your playstyle with full keyboard and mouse controls, offering greater flexibility and precision in combat and exploration.

[h2]Selected Graphics Options[/h2]
Tailor your visual experience with a variety of graphics settings, ensuring the game runs optimally on your hardware.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/3368c1523f9a6f670a7a97d9ed2507f5dd61f83c.png[/img]

[h2]Playable on Steam Deck[/h2]
Take your Shibuya action-packed experience on the go! REYNATIS is compatible with Steam Deck, delivering a smooth gaming experience wherever you are.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/c6fb99e6e23bb1412adf533dc34ec0d6a1d3b50c.jpg[/img]

And enjoy a special launch discount and exclusive bonuses until October 10!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/3edc689a08fd710065ca33357c2329d3826b3484.png[/img]
